Noa (AE): Quick help — Bluecrest procurement sent MSA+DPA redlines and insist on AWS CMKs for the POC. They want Hosted for speed and propose a monthly commit billing profile. Need legal/sec/finance take to reply. @Priya @Arjun @Maya
Priya (Legal): Please drop the redline PDF. Short answer: we don't permit customer CMKs on Hosted multi-tenant. We'll offer two options: Hosted w/ Redwood-managed keys or Dedicated/Private with CMKs + KMS addendum. If they insist, we can consider a Security Exception but it will be conditional.
Noa (AE): Uploaded: bluecrest_msa_redlines_v1.pdf and bluecrest_procurement_notes.pdf. They also want PO-first DocuSign routing and net60 payment terms.
Arjun (Security): CMKs on Hosted = no. Big operational & blast-radius risk. If they really need CMKs, Dedicated or Private only. Exception prerequisites: dedicated tenancy, cross-account key policy locked to customer's AWS account, audit log forwarding to their SIEM, documented key revoke runbook, quarterly attestation. No CMKs on Hosted.
Maya (Finance): Pricing note: for $28k/mo commit our standard cap is 6% and net30. Net60 + 10% needs RevOps+CFO sign-off. If they move to Dedicated we can do net45 + 7% at that volume, pending Security sign-off.
Noa (AE): Procurement says they cannot delay more than 72h; they pushed back on Dedicated lead time. Would an interim approach work: start Hosted with Redwood-managed keys for non-sensitive tests, then cut over to Dedicated for CMK workloads?
Arjun (Security): That's acceptable if contract explicitly forbids CMK use until Dedicated is live and we have the onboarding checklist completed. Provide a migration plan and an agreed cutover window. We'll not enable CMKs until the exception checklist is fully satisfied.
Priya (Legal): I'll craft a concise redline response: 1) Decline CMKs on Hosted; 2) Offer Hosted w/ Redwood keys or Dedicated with CMKs subject to KMS Addendum and Security Exception; 3) Include a clause: "If Customer requires CMKs, Customer will migrate workloads to Dedicated/Private and execute the KMS Addendum prior to any CMK use." Will annotate their redlines for indemnity/transfer issues.
Jules (Sales Ops): For DocuSign I need final orderform PDF + signer emails. They asked PO -> Bluecrest Legal -> Bluecrest PO sig -> Redwood Sales Ops -> Redwood Legal. Confirm who signs PO on our side (I can sign PO-only envelopes). Also, Priya: Legal wants a provisional watermark until security exception complete; procurement explicitly requested no watermark — which do we follow?
Priya (Legal): Legal policy: include "Provisional - pending Security Exception" watermark on our submitted docs. Don't send unwatermarked, final-signed docs until Security completes the exception. We'll accept a cover note explaining the provisional nature to procurement.
Maya (Finance): If they accept Dedicated after initial Hosted tests, I can approve net45 + 7% assuming Arjun signs off on the exception. Otherwise escalate for net60/10%.
Noa (AE): I'll propose the two-path option to procurement now (Hosted w/ Redwood keys — immediate start; Dedicated w/ CMKs — net45/7% & 48-72h provisioning + exception checklist). I'll attach our annotated redline and the KMS addendum template.
docbot: capacity-check.csv uploaded -> https://files.redwood.com/capacity/bluecrest_capacity.csv :white_check_mark:
Jules (Sales Ops): Once Noa confirms which option they choose, I'll assemble the DocuSign envelope with the signer order and add Legal watermark. Also note: add clause in envelope cover: "CMKs allowed only after Dedicated provisioning and executed KMS Addendum." Need signer emails to proceed.
Priya (Legal): One more legal flag: if their redlines include unlimited liability for key compromise or clause forcing us to hand over private key material, we will flatly refuse. I'll call out the exact lines in my response.
Arjun (Security): Ops note: reserved capacity for 99.95 SLA required for Dedicated => expect ~20% cost uplift. Also provisioning lead time 48-96h depending on capacity. We'll need the customer contact for security onboarding.
Noa (AE): Got it. Sending two-option reply now and asking if they accept Dedicated fallback. Will post their response here. Thanks team :thumbsup:
